notes.title: Release 1.0 hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Changed main menu popup. It now directs everyone to our soundtrack.
The tether notification now lets you know how to untether

notes.title: Release 1.0!
notes.notes:
GAMEPLAY

Flying Now Requires Stamina
Getting a game over clears your save
In multiplayer you can attach to players, making cooperation easier
The pyramid sends waves slower, and spawns baby mummies!
Kitty reclamation kidnaps one of your birds
Your starter birds get an additional 250 health
You start halfway to a perk
The Attack Frog no longer 1 hits you
Your birds stay farther from you while following
Starter birds have a chance of wearing a helmet
Starter birds have a random weapon
Starter birds have a random amount of XP
Rebalanced non player bird weapon damages
Rebalanced non player bird rank up stats
Ranged skill birds can keep the bow, and slingshot
Army birds take longer to flee when unarmed
Added more cages to the world, especially the Starter Forest
Kitty Reclamation won’t happen during events
Balanced quests, and rewards based on game time
Starter birds are always armed
All birds have +50 hp
The pyramid, and meteor tower spawn closer to you

ENEMIES

Enemies can now get on & spawn on barn roofs 
Canons shoot a chain shot that stops you from flying
Increased all enemy healths by 50
Increased nearly every enemies speed
The yeti is louder, and has graphics for his ground slam
Stopped the Cow Snake and Mosquito from obliterating birds
Added more enemies to the Starter Forest
The heroin kitty quickly runs home when being rape trained
Lowered many enemies damage to army birds
The gigga mummy has babies explode from her corpse
Level scaled the Mummy waves
Pilots are now a level 3 only enemy

WEAPONS

Lowered the range of all tier 3 weapons
Poop no longer completely stops enemies
Army birds can infinitely use the attack frog, every 30 to 60 seconds
Nerfed the poison dart frog as a weapon
Reduced how much the magic staff flings enemies
You can throw the spear 4 times, or 6 times with the weapon durability perk
You now start with a twig spear, not a frog

ITEMS

Chests can drop 2 items at once
The coconut is now edible
Forest trees have a higher chance of spawning loot
Grass and flowers no longer drop loot
Added more chests to the forest

BUILDINGS

Expanded the Desert town, it now has more buildings & enemies
Buffed the Bird Farm
The Birdbath and Bird farm cost more to build
The Cat Tree respawns enemies slower

UI

New 3d forge ui indicating where to & how to upgrade weapons
Made the boss battle ui larger because people weren’t seeing it
Notifications no longer block ui button interaction
The biome difficulty ui is larger because people weren’t seeing it
There’s a new Army notification type, with morse code sounds
Made the location of tutorial objects mentioned more in text
Load save buttons are now green
Added hints to the loading screen
Added “Jakbolt” to roadrunner names
Added “Jakob” to penguin names
There’s a new Release trailer for ‘Love Birds’
Setup a donation site with buy me a coffee
Changed support popup in main menu

FIXED BUGS

Fixed a bug when trying to load on the first open of the game
Fixed the birdhouse guard not shooting enemies
Fixed the kitty base spawning in mid air
Fixed the Jungle enemies unloading while in combat
Fixed kitty cave navigation for enemies
Fixed saving the army damage boost perk
Fixed the flintlock not going away when unequiped for army birds
Fixed map ui staying on when the map is closed
Fixed the banana slingshot not hitting enemies
Fixed unarmed bots chasing enemies
Fixed the bird farm not spawning loot
Fixed army birds ignoring the Ogre Kitty
Fixed Sorcerers teleporting underground
Fixed the slingshot not playing music
Fixed duping weapons with army bird pickup
Fixed the game over screen taking a long time to appear
Fixed weapon re-equip on respawn
